# Notes CUJs

## F1 · Notes

### CUJ-1 · Write a note and find it again · P0 · phone
Proves: R1, R2
User action: tap "New note" -> type -> "Save".
- The note shows in the list.

### CUJ-2 · Delete a note · P1 · manual
Proves: R3
User action: open a note -> "Delete note" -> confirm.

## F2 · Search

### CUJ-3 · Find a note by title · P1 · phone
Proves: R4
User action: type in "Search notes".
